findings.text: The stow stop strikes a separate stop lug plate stack (7/8 in striking plate, skin lobe, 1/2 in outboard plate; screwed and pinned) whose striking face is 5 mm behind the lip back face at |Y|=149.5. The 2 mm lip panel alone gives about 12 N/mm (see structure.json). The stow contact is (85.21, +/-149.5, 512.03) mm with push direction (0.2397, 0.9708). The lever is 100.00 mm, so K = 2 x k_pad x 0.1^2 is unchanged.

Chassis bodies by root occurrence: {'Red 2 inset structural machining:1': 139, 'Serviceable brace revision:1': 7}. The recipe resolves each referenced body to its own occurrence path and anchors to the occurrence that owns 'Upper pan stringer 1'.

Existing truss-to-stringer nodes are plugged butt joints: a plug inside each member 0/2 top, four blind rivets (two through each of two opposite walls) and one #10-32 SHCS down through the stringer bottom wall. Coped members 1/3/5 join members 0/2 with 1/8 in rear-face gussets below Z 468. No weld. The cradles sit 1.5 mm above the member top faces.
See structure.json rulesCheck: start height and the 18 in extension limit both pass, so the geometry is unchanged for rules.
